stops.note: a family from Casarsa della Delizia in Friuli; seven brothers emigrated to California in the 1900s-1920s and built aircraft propellers and pumps
Candido Jacuzzi adapted a pump in 1956 to give hydrotherapy to his son, who had rheumatoid arthritis; Roy Jacuzzi launched the integrated whirlpool bath in 1968

current_meaning: a large bath with underwater jets of water (trademark)
